messages:
alex: Heads up — multiple customers reporting a sharp p95/p99 latency increase after yesterday's quantization profile rollout. Slacking root thread so we can correlate.

maria: Seeing same in the dashboard. p95 for open-instruct-7b went from ~210ms -> ~520ms, p99 spiked to ~1.2s on hosted. Affected across regions. :thinking_face:

support_raj: Customer ticket #C-8792 reported timeouts hitting client SDK around 10:30 UTC. They started hitting retry storms.

sre_jamie: I pulled traces — bottleneck looks like kernel selection jitter + repeated KV cache misses for int8 runtime. Sampling trace id: trace-7f3a9.

ml_tess: We enabled "quant_profile=dynamic_scale_v2" + int8 path for a subset of models yesterday. Calibration telemetry shows a non-trivial increase in average decode loop time for longer prefixes. Suspect fallback/backoff loop in runtime when per-token quant error exceeds threshold.

alex: Repro steps requested. raj can you get a minimal curl + payload that triggers the spike? Also which model variant exactly?

support_raj: Confirmed repro with this curl (sanitized):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"open-instruct-7b:int8-dyn-v2","input":"<long prefix ~1k tokens>...","max_tokens":256,"stream":false}'
```
Repro runs on our staging customer key show p95 ~480ms.

ml_tess: Thanks. I instrumented a local run: when prefix length > 512 tokens the int8 decode loop does ~2x kernel rebinds and triggers a software emulation path at some attention heads. That explains latency tail.

sre_jamie: Quick mitigation idea — toggle calibration threshold up so runtime tolerates bigger quant error and avoid the emulation fallback. That is a config change: `quant.tolerance = 0.015` -> `0.03`.

maria: Can we do a targeted canary change for hosted-only customers on int8 profile? We should not impact dedicated/private.

alex: Agreed — plan: 1) Canary config bump for only the int8 dynamic profile on two lowest-volume regions, 2) Add a temporary rule to route long-prefix requests (>512 tokens) to fp16 variant, 3) Notify customers and support.

ops-bot: deploy: config-change applied to canary pool us-west-2-canary at 3111113000. (simulated event)

ml_tess: After applying the higher tolerance on canary the p95 dropped from 480ms -> 220ms in test runs, p99 lowered significantly. Quality checks on eval set show negligible degradation (BLEU/ROUGE difference within noise).

support_raj: Customer-facing mitigation: added per-tenant routing rule. For tenants with recent timeouts we'll route to `open-instruct-7b:fp16-stable` until we confirm full rollout.

alex: Let's prepare rollback playbook in case calibration causes semantic drift for edge prompts: 1) revert quant.tolerance, 2) force model to fp16, 3) blacklist dynamic profile for affected tenants. Who owns the rollback ops?

sre_jamie: SRE will run rollback if p99 > 900ms for 15m window post-rollout. I'll own the automation.

maria: Also add telemetry to capture per-head quant-error histogram and kernel-bind-count per-request so we can detect the emulation hot path earlier.

ml_tess: Filed internal eval job to run ~5k prompts across our regression suite with the bumped tolerance and with fp16 baseline — linking results to the ticket.

support_raj: Notifying impacted customers about temporary routing and ETA ~2h for broader canary. I'll paste templated message in the ticket.

alex: Nice work. After we confirm canary is stable, stepwise rollout with monitoring thresholds: p95 delta <= +20ms and p99 <= +50ms relative to baseline. If exceeded, auto-stop.

ops-bot: alert: p99 spike detected on eu-central-1 at 3111113300 — SRE starting investigation.

sre_jamie: Investigating eu-central spike — looks like a separate node-level kernel regression caused a config drift. Isolating nodes and failing over.

ml_tess: Noted. We'll pause global rollout until eu-central is clean. Also adding a fallback in runtime: when quant-error histogram shows heavy tail, immediately route that request to fp16 variant instead of triggering emulation path. That should avoid long tails.

alex: Final ask: support, collect all affected tenant ids + sample requests. SRE, capture perf traces and node logs. ML, prepare a short note on why dynamic_scale_v2 caused this and recommended permanent changes (tighter per-head calibration and faster emulation bail). We'll sync in #eng-runtime in 30m. :thumbsup:
